players.product: Conductive-polymer solid capacitors (coiled and chip-type, V-Chip / CAP) and hybrid capacitors for power regulation on server / AI server, motherboard, VGA and notebook boards

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 revenue reached a record NT$1,370.09 million, +20.4% YoY and +21.4% QoQ; H1 2026 revenue NT$2,498.3 million (+22.31% YoY). Q2 2026 gross profit NT$470,811 thousand, gross margin 34.4%; H1 gross margin 35.5%, with gross profit up 26% YoY. Q2 net profit NT$185,564 thousand (+133.63% YoY), net margin 13.5%; H1 net profit NT$367.22 million (+76%); EPS NT$2.31 in Q2 and NT$4.42 in H1 (+75%). July 2026 revenue a record monthly high of NT$505.82 million, +34.8% YoY (NT$375.30 million in July 2025).
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue NT$1,370.09 million (+20.4% YoY, +21.4% QoQ); H1 gross margin 35.5%; July 2026 revenue NT$505.82 million (record)

quarterly_data.signal: Product and application mix: in Q2 2026 CAP remained the primary revenue driver (CAP > Vchip > DIP); CAP revenue surged QoQ on robust server demand and sustained notebook design-ins, Vchip revenue rose QoQ on higher-ASP server orders, and DIP kept declining on weak PC demand. Top applications in Q2 and H1 2026: Server > NB > MB (branded) > MB (ODM), with the Server and NB contribution expanding and branded MB declining. H1 2026 product mix: CAP 44%, SMD (Vchip) 32%, DIP 20%, Hybrid 3%, EL-CAP 1%; YoY: CAP +77.3%, Vchip +34.2%, Hybrid +142.5%, DIP -32.8%, EL-CAP -42.2% (motherboard demand revised sharply down).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026: CAP 44% of revenue (+77.3% YoY), Vchip 32% (+34.2%), Hybrid +142.5%; Server the top application

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: last year-end's expansions brought monthly capacity to Vchip 100 million units and CAP 60 million units, behind substantial YoY growth on server demand. The company is accelerating yield improvements for high-spec CAP while expanding monthly capacity targets to 80 million units by November 2026 and 100 million units by January 2027, to penetrate Server, NB, VGA and Switch markets. Manufacturing locations: China x2 (Hubei, Wuxi), Taiwan x1 and Thailand x1, the Thailand factory manufacturing AP-CON.
quarterly_data.figure: monthly capacity Vchip 100 million / CAP 60 million units; target 80 million units by November 2026 and 100 million by January 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook: surging memory and storage prices plus rising cost pressures have contracted PC shipments; server supply remains prioritized and less affected, though component shortages and uncoordinated kit readiness continue to cause demand fluctuations. Sustained expansion in server demand drives revenue growth, supported by qualification and design-ins of high-spec CAP, Vchip and Hybrid capacitors; as high-spec CAP capacity comes online in H2, shipments to Server and NB will scale up and Vchip and Hybrid shipments will rise on strong server demand. The company projects continuous revenue growth, with consecutive record-breaking quarters, alongside steady gross margin expansion.
